name: Cattle Crossing
spec: yellow diamond with a black cow symbol
meaning: Livestock may be on the road ahead.

snippets.back: Warning signs also flag slippery-when-wet pavement, a narrow bridge, cattle crossings and deer crossings.
Wildlife may dart onto the road in unexpected places, and livestock may get out when people leave gates open or cut fences.
An Open Range sign identifies an area where livestock may roam unfenced and have the right of way.
Avoid sounding the horn near horses or livestock because it may frighten them; approach or pass riders carefully and be ready to stop.
For an otherwise nonreportable crash injuring or killing a dog, cat or livestock, take reasonable steps to notify the owner or, if unavailable, law enforcement or animal control.
The farmer endorsement lets farm operations move equipment, livestock and produce, and it may call for a general knowledge test and a combination vehicles test.
A Range Cattle warning indicates that cattle or horses may be on an unfenced highway.
In farm country or open land where livestock or deer may cross, slow down for an animal in the road until it has passed, since animals move unpredictably.

result.summary: MT states Range Cattle warning means cattle or horses may be on unfenced highway, matching livestock on road; no snippet describes yellow diamond with black cow symbol.
